languages_frameworks: MCP (mcp>=1.12,<2; FastMCP streamable HTTP mounted at /mcp)
OSV.dev + deps.dev + GitHub APIs; govulncheck (Go) via docker

implemented_capabilities.capability: Dependency-path blast radius: advisory -> package -> service shortestPath, upstream callers, internet exposure path
implemented_capabilities.notes: Cypher shortestPath((s:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..15]->(p:Package)) from advisory AFFECTS packages, variable-length (:Service)-[:CALLS*0..6] upstream traversal and shortest exposed-entry path. Verdict (AFFECTED / NOT_AFFECTED / NEEDS_HUMAN) comes from a deterministic judge; LLM cannot alter it. Priority P0/P1/P2/DEV = severity x exposure, demoted when govulncheck proves the function is not called.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Function-level reachability for Go via govulncheck, ingested as REACHES edges
implemented_capabilities.notes: Runs govulncheck inside a golang docker container (collect, subprocess docker run), compacts the JSON stream to called/imported/required levels and stores (Service)-[:REACHES {level,symbol,stack}]->(Advisory). Go only; npm/PyPI/Maven have no reachability. Committed snapshot lets the demo run offline.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Service topology discovered from Kubernetes/compose manifests, lockfile parsers, CODEOWNERS ownership
implemented_capabilities.notes: Parses npm/uv/requirements/go.mod/pom lockfiles (Maven expanded via deps.dev), resolves env-var service URLs in manifests into CALLS edges and exposure flags; curated tenants (otel, boutique, anthos) are real public projects with a committed raw snapshot; 'bring your repo' ingests any public GitHub repo with size/count caps.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Decision memory with SUPERSEDES edges (knowledge currency) and precedent recall
implemented_capabilities.notes: Heuristic regex over dependency-manifest commit messages creates (:Decision)-[:DOCUMENTED_IN]->(:Commit) and (:Decision)-[:CONCERNS]->(:Package|:Service); within a service, a newer decision about the same package SUPERSEDES the previous one (computed by date ordering, brain.py:82-91). Human decisions (patched / not_affected / accepted_risk) become (:Case)-[:ABOUT]->(:Advisory) per session and are recalled as precedents; exact not_affected VEX precedent short-circuits triage.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Session-scoped episodic/semantic/procedural memory and agent handoff trace graph
implemented_capabilities.notes: (:Run)-[:HAS_STEP]->(:Step) with (:Step)-[:HANDS_OFF_TO]->(:Step) records the Triage -> Investigator -> Judge -> Remediator handoff; playbook success/failure counts are derived from cases linked by USED. 'Agents' are labelled stages of one deterministic function, not independent LLM agents.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Advisory watcher / rescan for new advisories since the graph was built
implemented_capabilities.notes: Re-queries OSV for every Package, writes only advisories not already known (first_seen timestamp), runs risk_board and reports new P-ranked findings; a global lock prevents concurrent rescans. It detects new evidence but does not re-open earlier Cases/precedents.

implemented_capabilities.capability: OpenVEX export of human decisions and CI gate with SARIF
implemented_capabilities.notes: VEX maps patched->fixed, not_affected->not_affected(+impact statement), accepted_risk->affected(+action_statement). CI mode builds the graph from the working tree in a throwaway FalkorDB container and fails the build on new P0/P1 findings relative to a baseline.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Conversational layer: Gemini tool-calling with deterministic offline router
implemented_capabilities.notes: LLM only picks tools and phrases answers; tools are read-only and validated; with no GEMINI_API_KEY a regex router answers. MCP server (stdio and /mcp HTTP) exposes the same toolkit, strictly read-only when BR_PUBLIC=1.

CALL algo.pageRank('Service','CALLS') for service criticality; bench fires N concurrent agent-style triage loops against FalkorDB and counts 'Max pending queries exceeded' backpressure retries (db.py handles them with jittered backoff).

graph_models_and_cypher: One graph per tenant named br_<tenant> (db.py:graph_name). Labels: Meta{k:'tenant',repo,exposure_known,kind,built_at,last_scan}, Service{name,exposed,kind,reach_analyzed}, Package{key,eco,name,version,dev}, Advisory{id,cve,severity,summary,first_seen}, Alias, Owner{kind person|bot|team}, Commit, Decision{text,rationale,kind,date,author}, Discussion, Case{sid,decision,rationale,actor,outcome,reused}, Playbook, Run{sid}, Step. Edges: DEPENDS_ON, CALLS, AFFECTS{fixed}, ALIAS_OF, OWNS, COMMITTED{count,last}, TOUCHED, DOCUMENTED_IN, CONCERNS, SUPERSEDES, DISCUSSED_IN, REACHES{level,symbol,stack}, ABOUT, IN, USED, HAS_STEP, HANDS_OFF_TO. Patterns: shortestPath with *1..15, *0..6, OPTIONAL MATCH superseding decision, UNWIND bulk MERGE, UNION, CALL algo.pageRank (FalkorDB-native; no Neo4j GDS/APOC). Agent/read path uses ro_query with regex write-keyword rejection and timeout; every query returns a trace {cypher, params, ms, rows} shown in the UI.
algorithms: shortestPath over DEPENDS_ON*1..15 to enumerate service-to-vulnerable-package chains (queries.py:Q_PATHS, Q_FINDINGS)
Bounded upstream traversal CALLS*0..6 with min path length per caller (queries.py:Q_CALLERS) and shortest exposed-entry path (Q_CALL_PATH)
Deterministic priority matrix: severity rank x exposure x runtime-vs-dev x govulncheck reachability demotion (triage.py:_priority/risk_board)
Decision supersession by chronological ordering per (service, package) (brain.py:_decisions)
Precedent matching by advisory id or shared package names within session (memory.py:Q_PRECEDENT)
Sliding-window rate limiter (security.py:Limiter) and jittered exponential backoff on FalkorDB queue-full errors (db.py:_with_backoff)
backend_interfaces: MCP: stdio (python -m blastradius.mcp_server) and streamable HTTP mounted at /mcp
CLI: python -m blastradius.ingest|brain|discussions|watch|reach|ci; GitHub Action (action.yml) with SARIF output
frontend_interfaces: Next.js app (web/src/app/page.tsx) with components GraphCanvas, RepoAnalyzer, ResultPanel, Views, Bench, ui
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Triage -> Investigator -> Judge (no LLM) -> Remediator pipeline whose steps are persisted as Run/Step with HANDS_OFF_TO edges; Gemini only chooses tools and phrases answers. Session-scoped Case memory (episodic), Advisory/Package facts (semantic), Playbook nodes with derived success/failure counts (procedural); MAX_CASES/MAX_RUNS retention pruning. Remediator actions are 'pending_approval' proposals only; nothing is executed.
tests_present: backend/tests/test_core.py (13 tests) and test_features.py (25 tests), ~38 total, requiring a live FalkorDB; backend/evals/run.py + EVALS.md cross-check discovered topology against hand-written reference_calls from project docs.
dependency_requirements: FalkorDB server image falkordb/falkordb:v4.14.10 in action.yml (older than 4.22)
docker + golang image for govulncheck collection
security_findings: NO LICENSE FILE in repository: reuse relies solely on the user-attested owner permission

backend/blastradius/reach.py:55 - subprocess.run(['docker','run',...]) with REPO and DIRS env derived from the static TENANTS table, executes `go install ...@latest`, `git clone` and `govulncheck` inside a container; only invoked by the offline 'collect' CLI, not from the API
backend/blastradius/db.py:12,57-62 - agent read path relies on a regex deny-list over Cypher with string literals stripped plus ro_query; server-side read-only is the real control

action.yml:22-30 - GitHub Action interpolates ${{ inputs.path }}, ${{ inputs.fail-on }} and ${{ inputs.baseline }} directly into a bash run script (workflow script-injection risk if inputs are attacker-controlled); also starts falkordb container without auth on localhost
backend/blastradius/security.py:23-28 - client_ip trusts the last X-Forwarded-For hop only when BR_PUBLIC is set (acceptable behind own proxy)
backend/blastradius/api.py:49-51 - CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' when not public

backend/blastradius/api.py:252-262 - POST /api/ingest is unauthenticated, triggers outbound GitHub fetches for arbitrary public repos (mitigated by REPO_RE, MAX_FILE_BYTES, MAX_SERVICES, one-job lock, 3/hour rate rule)

backend/blastradius/agent.py:187, llm.py:14 - GEMINI_API_KEY read from environment; brain.py/ingest.py read optional GITHUB_TOKEN; no hard-coded secrets found; advisory and commit text are sent to Gemini
backend/blastradius/ingest.py:39-46 - local-root file reads are realpath/commonpath-confined (good)
duplicates_or_overlaps: Directly overlaps the blast-radius / dependency-vulnerability triage family (Software Dependency Intelligence): reachable (DevAnuragT), blast-radius (kushalkumarcs372, AgentAhmed, sevenhiremath) and Blastradius siblings. Distinct for decision supersession, VEX export, CI/SARIF gate and Go govulncheck reachability.
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - has explicit (:Decision)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(:Decision), per-session Case precedents, first_seen on advisories, a rescan watcher and VEX statements with timestamps, but supersession is a chronological commit heuristic and a rescan does not invalidate or re-open dependent Cases or precedents.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Small, readable FalkorDB patterns for decision supersession, precedent recall, step-level handoff trace and rescan-for-new-evidence; the dependency shortestPath + exposure + reachability priority matrix in queries.py/triage.py is a ready dependency-blast-radius pack.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB; network to OSV/deps.dev/GitHub for ingestion; docker only for optional govulncheck collection; Gemini key optional

strategy_rationale: Best taken as a Software Dependency Intelligence pack (queries, triage judge, VEX export, watcher) behind Kairos's shared engine, with the decision-supersession and precedent patterns borrowed for the evidence graph. Because there is no license file, any code lift depends on the attested permission and should be recorded.
